associations.rationale: The type only introduces an opaque parameter family indexed by the characteristic and does not display the classification.
The type gives an equivalence between quotients built from opaque parameter and irreducible setoids, without displaying what the classifying parameters are.
The type supplies only the existence half: every finite irreducible module is equivalent to some parameterized carrier.
The type proves that each parameterized carrier is irreducible, a soundness component of a classification.
The type relates isomorphism of two family members to an opaque same-invariant condition, providing only a uniqueness component.
The type negates the claim that every finite irreducible module has dimension below p, a dimensional obstruction rather than a classification.
The type bounds the dimension of every finite irreducible module by p, a structural constraint rather than the requested classification.
